title: The same tick-cascade works on the Schedule card
custom_preconds: 1. In the Schedule card, View, Create & Edit and Delete are all unticked.
custom_steps:
1. Find the Schedule card.
  2. Tick Delete.
  3. Look at the three boxes.
custom_expected: View, Create & Edit and Delete all become ticked.
evidence: UI: Schedule card tick Delete auto-ticks Create & Edit + View (all ON).
